candidate_query:
MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec)
WHERE sec.sectionTitle =~ '(?i).*(PDCCH).*'
OPTIONAL MATCH (sec)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(tbl:TSTable)
RETURN sec.sectionId AS sectionId, collect(DISTINCT tbl.tableId) AS tableIds
ORDER BY sectionId
